SELECT g.group_id AS groupId, g.group_name AS groupName, m.role AS roleName, COUNT(m2.group_member_id) AS memberCount FROM group_member m JOIN group_table g ON m.group_id = g.group_id LEFT JOIN group_member m2 ON g.group_id = m2.group_id AND m2.is_active = 1 WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_active = 1 GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name, m.role;
